comparison_limitations: Five developer-selected company samples; 20 frozen paragraphs each, not entire-report accuracy.
Agent labels are non-blind diagnostic suggestions, not independent gold.
Exact quote validation checks copying, not semantic assertion quality or evidence attribution.
Multiple experiments reused the same development inputs; no held-out accuracy estimate.

unseen_page_agent_diagnostic.method: Worker instructed to label input only and reported model-output blinding; not human gold or independently audited blinding.
